purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Farnham

queries.query: Farnham Surrey official parcel map GIS cadastral land parcels council
queries.result: First-party discovery identified HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE Index Polygons information/download pages and INSPIRE WMS, plus Surrey County Council's official interactive-map service catalog. HM Land Registry's open INSPIRE dataset covers indicative freehold registered-property polygons in England and Wales; the complete National Polygon Service is licensed and chargeable. Surrey's public service catalog did not list a cadastral parcel layer.

queries.language: English (local-language check; United Kingdom local administrative language is English)
queries.query: Farnham Surrey official land registry map parcel boundaries
queries.result: The independent local-language-equivalent check used English because English is the relevant local administrative language. It independently identified HM Land Registry guidance and Farnham Town Council planning-map material; the planning maps are not cadastral parcel services. No separate Farnham or Waverley public cadastral API was evidenced.

registryEvidence.custodian: HM Land Registry is the first-party national registry/cadastral-index custodian for England and Wales. Its INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset provides indicative freehold registered-property polygons; the separate National Polygon Service includes freehold and leasehold titles but is licensed and chargeable.
registryEvidence.locality: Farnham, Surrey, England, United Kingdom; national HMLR coverage applies, but no Farnham/Waverley-specific public cadastral custodian was evidenced.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes an applicable national first-party source, not proof that every WUP locality point is covered or that the open freehold subset equals a complete cadastral parcel layer.

parcelDiscovery.nativeIdentityObserved: The INSPIRE/WMS capabilities identify CP.CadastralParcel as the cadastral-parcel map layer, but no safe feature identifier or vector geometry was returned by the executed public requests.
parcelDiscovery.crs: WMS capabilities expose EPSG:27700, EPSG:3035, EPSG:900913, and CRS:84. No vector response was retained.

boundedResponse.requestScope: Official HMLR INSPIRE WMS GetMap request for CP.CadastralParcel around the exact WUP point, BBOX -0.7570,51.2769,-0.7542,51.2790 in CRS:84, 512x512 PNG; no parcel attributes or vector geometry requested.
boundedResponse.note: The bounded request returned HTTP 200 image/png. The WFS capabilities request returned ServiceUnavailable: Service WFS is disabled. The layer was not converted or inferred into polygons, and no GeoJSON sample was retained.

exactPointQuery.note: No exact-point feature query was available: the public WMS CP.CadastralParcel layer was not queryable through the attempted GetFeatureInfo request. This is an unavailable-query result, not evidence of parcel absence; the coordinate was not shifted.

parcelDiscovery.note: No retained GeoJSON was created because no unchanged safe vector parcel feature with a native identity was obtained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: First-party HM Land Registry dataset page retrieved by discovery; identifies open INSPIRE Index Polygons, local-authority files, OGL, and WMS/download links.
First-party HMLR National Polygon Service page identified the licensed chargeable national polygon dataset and its title/UPRN data; no account or API key used.
HTTP 200; WMS capabilities exposed inspire:CP.CadastralParcel and CRS EPSG:27700/CRS:84 with England-and-Wales extent.
HTTP 200 exception report; ServiceUnavailable with text 'Service WFS is disabled'.
HTTP 200 image/png for a bounded map request around the exact WUP point; raster only, no attributes or vector geometry retained.
HTTP 200 exception report; LayerNotQueryable, so no exact-point feature identity or geometry was returned.
HTTP 200; official Surrey public service catalog inspected. Listed boundary, countryside, environment, heritage, learning, community, and transport services; no cadastral parcel service was listed.
Official HMLR procedure retrieved; index-map searches require an address/plan/OS reference and are not an anonymous parcel-vector API.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity when exposed
full native parcel geometry when a parcel source is proven
uncertainty: The exact WUP point [51.2779073993314, -0.755591034770066] was preserved and not shifted. No exact-point feature result was available because the WMS layer was not queryable.

The HMLR open INSPIRE source is a freehold registered-property subset with indicative index polygons; the complete National Polygon Service is licensed and chargeable. Neither was treated as a complete citywide cadastral source.
Surrey County Council's inspected public map catalog did not evidence a local parcel layer; Farnham Town Council planning maps are not cadastral source integration.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe request was used.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
